ops.body:
synckit implementation launched: Run wf_8c2b365b-522 against contract cc-notes doc 6c3cec2. The doc combines the core mapping's delivery-v2/deliverer/status design with the transport mapping's resumable batches over the reviewed netpolicy API, and states the root requirements explicitly:
- R1: the receiver evaluates its own LIVE netpolicy state on every batch.begin/batch.put before writing. A sender-cached peer state never authorizes later parts.
- R2: the ChangeID hashes the v2 domain + ordered artifact roots, and the receiver re-derives the roots from the payload.
- R3: acknowledge is a ChangeID CAS with monotonic Acked, and supersede runs while the peer is offline.
- R4: apply.v2 computes readiness from its own store.

Worktrees:
- foundation/integration /Users/yasyf/.claude/worktrees/synckit/delivery (branch cc-sync/artifact-delivery, based on netpolicy 1215e002)
- build lanes /Users/yasyf/.claude/worktrees/synckit/{artifact-store,syncservice-v2,delivery-v2}

Stages: integration adds real-store e2e tests (corrupt/interrupted parts, receiver cellular flip mid-batch, offline supersede with late ACK, relay, 40 kicks, zero-byte unchanged). Then astra finder lenses and an opus fix pass. The cc-sync repo skeleton exists at /Users/yasyf/Code/cc-sync (bootstrap lane).
